name: Ramgopal Polytex Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Ramgopal Polytex Ltd is in the business of trading in commodities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
RGPL is engaged in the wholesale trading of commodities such as Yarn, Polymers, etc. The company either imports or procures locally and sells them on a wholesale basis. Its Polyester 
Filament Yarns (PFY) are used in active sportswear and technical textiles, and spandex yarn in yoga wear, gym wear, swimwear, compression garments, and also in medical textiles such as orthopaedic supports, bandages, and compression stockings

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -17.3% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -8.43% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 1,013 days to 2,326 days
